recipe_version.title: Sichuan Dan Dan Noodles with Crisp Pork and Sesame Chili Sauce
recipe_version.description: Wheat noodles tossed in a sauce of Chinese sesame paste, chili oil, soy sauce, black vinegar, sugar, ground Sichuan peppercorn, and garlic, topped with crisp-cooked ground pork seasoned with Shaoxing wine and soy sauce, blanched baby bok choy, and scallions.

ingredients.display_name: chili oil with sediment whose label lists soybean oil, chili, and Sichuan pepper

ingredients.name: black vinegar
ingredients.display_name: Chinese black vinegar whose label lists water, glutinous rice, wheat bran, and salt

ingredients.name: Shaoxing wine
ingredients.display_name: Shaoxing wine whose label lists water, glutinous rice, wheat, and salt

ingredients.name: fresh wheat noodles
ingredients.display_name: fresh thin wheat noodles whose label lists wheat flour, water, and salt

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Toast the Sichuan peppercorns in the dry skillet over medium until fragrant, about 1 minute, then grind them. Grate the garlic, quarter the bok choy, and slice the scallions.

steps.title: Boil the pot
steps.body: Bring 12 cups water to a boil in the 6-quart pot over high, about 12 minutes to come to a boil.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.body: While the pot heats (overlap stated): divide the sesame paste, chili oil, 3 tbsp soy sauce, black vinegar, sugar, ground peppercorns, and garlic among the 4 serving bowls and stir each into a thick sauce.

steps.title: Crisp the pork
steps.body: While the pot heats (overlap stated): heat the oil in the 12-inch skillet over medium-high, about 1 minute. Cook the pork, breaking it up, until browned and crisp in bits, about 7 minutes. Add the Shaoxing wine and 1 tbsp soy sauce and cook until dry, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Cook noodles and greens
steps.body: Boil the noodles in the 6-quart pot of 12 cups water until just tender, about 3 minutes, adding the bok choy for the last minute. Scoop out 1/2 cup noodle cooking liquid in the liquid measuring cup, then drain in the colander.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Stir 2 tbsp of the noodle cooking liquid into the sauce in each bowl, add noodles and bok choy, and top with pork and scallions. Toss at the table.

Compared with sesame-soba-noodle-bowl: hot wheat noodles in a numbing chili sauce, not cool soba. Compared with sichuan-mapo-tofu-shiitake: a noodle bowl with crisp pork, not a tofu braise over rice.
